adoption.rationale: The pinned helper sends AUTHENTICATE, SIGNAL NEWNYM, and QUIT in one control-port stream, then logs success when grep finds 250 OK anywhere in the combined reply. The standing script comment says exit rotation is mandatory; the Tor control specification ties 250 OK to command success and defines non-250 errors. The contract checks that the status of SIGNAL NEWNYM, rather than an earlier authentication reply, controls the result.

declared_domain: CRLF-delimited ASCII Tor ControlPort response lines for the three commands issued by send_newnym, including a successful 250 authentication reply followed by a 5xx signal error; no NUL. The property models the response transcript and the real pinned shell function is replayed with a local fake nc command.
guarantee: send_newnym reports success only when the reply to SIGNAL NEWNYM is successful; a prior AUTHENTICATE success must not make a later signal failure look successful.
input_source: ASCII Tor ControlPort replies to the local AUTHENTICATE, SIGNAL NEWNYM, QUIT command sequence sent by the rotator.
